te: In Novocherkassk found the bodies of spouses-pensioners
de: Bodies of spouses-pensioners with signs of violent death found in Novocherkassk, Rostov region, opened a criminal case on murder, reports SUSK

d: Российские биатлонисты, несмотря на отстранение, остаются конкурентоспособными и смогут бороться за высшие места на этапах Кубка мира в случае возвращения,…

te: The forum "Made in Russia" was visited by more than 5 thousand guests
de: The “Made in Russia” forum was visited by more than five thousand guests, including over a thousand foreign representatives from 89 countries of near and far abroad…

te: In Jordan, a military helicopter crashed
de: A Black Hawk helicopter from the Jordanian army crashed during a training flight, a rescue operation was launched, the press service of the armed forces reported…
